en.bdb: End of the truth and falsehood

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਗਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kooR sutaa sach jaagadhaa sach saahib dhe man bhaiaa|

en.bdb: Since the falsehood sleeps while the truth remains awake, the truth is loved by that Lord God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਹਰੂ ਸਚ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਉਤੇ ਬਹਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach sachai kar paaharoo sach bha(n)ddaar ute bahilaiaa|

en.bdb: The true Lord has appointed truth as the watchman and has made it to sit at the store of truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਆਗੂ ਆਨ੍ਹੇਰ ਕੂੜ ਉਝੜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach aagoo aanher kooR ujhaR dhoojaa bhaau chalaiaa|

en.bdb: The truth is the guide and the falsehood is the darkness which causes people to wander in the jungle of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਕਰਿ ਫਉਜਦਾਰੁ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਵਣ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach sache kar faujadhaar raahu chalaavan jog paThaiaa|

en.bdb: Appointing truth as the commander, the true Lord has made it competent to take people along path of righteousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਭਵਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਚਾੜੑਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jag bhavajal mil saadhasa(n)g gur bohithai chaaR(h)h taraiaa|

en.bdb: To get people across the world ocean, the truth as Guru, has taken the people across in the vessel as the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੜਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਰਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kaam krodh lobh moh faR aha(n)kaar garadhan maravaiaa|

en.bdb: Lust, anger, greed, infatuation and ego have been killed by holding them from their necks.
Those who have got the perfect Guru, have gone across (the world ocean).
